title: Susan Gough's psychological operations role as a source for the WSJ article
place_text: Booz Allen Hamilton / Department of Defense, USA

tellings.quote: One of the articles primary sources is Susan Gough, whose own LinkedIn, along with independent sources, confirms her lead role in Booz Allen Hamilton's Psychological Operations Consulting Practice for the Department of Defense.

plain: The Wall Street Journal article "The Pentagon Disinformation That Fueled America's UFO Mythology," published in 2025, relies on Susan Gough as one of its main sources. Michels says, citing her own LinkedIn profile and independent sources, that she held a lead role in the psychological operations practice at Booz Allen Hamilton, a defense consulting firm that does this work for the Department of Defense. Psychological operations means military work meant to shape what people believe, so Michels raises it to suggest the article itself may be shaping opinion rather than simply reporting.
